notes.title: MultiWheel Update
notes.content: [p]2024-9-20 MultiWheel Update[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Adds support for multiple wheels![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637463/67802e96049540a84bbcf2a5f3695b06a8033247.png"][/img][/p][p]After updating no wheels will show until one is enabled from the Edit Wheel window.[/p][p]Select your wheel and click Enable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637463/322568129aab5eb8d09582d4ebbea3f5dd33ae4e.png"][/img][/p]
